top_signals.title: European Stocks Hit Fresh Record as AI Unwind Boosts Region
top_signals.summary: European stocks surpassed their prior closing record high as the region extended an outperformance driven by a rotation out of the artificial intelligence trade and a strong earnings season.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: M&G tilts focus to life channel as asset management demand stalls
top_signals.summary: A sharp acceleration in bulk purchase annuities stopped M&G from sliding into net outflows in the third quarter, as asset management demand slowed.
